title: US government funding deadline (shutdown risk)
note: Stopgap law P.L. 119-103 (H.R. 6500) funds the government to the end of 11 Dec; a lapse would start 12 Dec. As of 17 Nov, no new stopgap text released; the White House is reportedly weighing one running to March. A shutdown can delay BLS data (CPI, jobs) and SEC work, and tends to add risk-off noise.
